in_marathi.name: Ankit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ankit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ankit is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अन्कित’ (Ankita) meaning ‘not to be moved, immovable, firm or strong’. This name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is known for his unwavering strength and stability.
